# Fantasy Front Office

Fantasy Front Office is the first working product shell for a fantasy football agent that combines roster optimization, coach tendencies, defensive matchup intelligence, league psychology, waiver planning, trade strategy, social publishing, and dynasty scouting.

Status: early-stage MVP / product prototype. It uses demo data and a deterministic scoring engine today, with the structure meant to plug into live data later:

- Sleeper league, roster, draft, matchup, and transaction sync
- Yahoo OAuth fantasy sync
- ESPN browser extension overlay and later direct league sync
- X filtered stream ingestion for breaking NFL signals
- Instagram creator publishing queue
- NFL data provider feeds for injuries, stats, depth charts, betting lines, and weather
- Coach, coordinator, and defensive tendency knowledge base

## What This Shows

- Building an agent-style product around a messy real-world decision workflow
- Translating sports, social, roster, league, and timing signals into ranked actions
- Designing product surfaces for operators, not just static dashboards
- Planning integrations, data boundaries, testing workflows, and launch operations
- Shipping in phases with documentation, screenshots, and a working local prototype

## Run

Start the local API:

```bash
npm run api
```

Start the frontend:

```bash
npm run dev -- --port 5173
```

Frontend: http://127.0.0.1:5173/  
API: http://127.0.0.1:8787/

## Current Product Surface

- Lineup command center
- Phase 5 deterministic agent scoring model
- Player scorecards with component breakdowns and failure cases
- Phase 6 explanation briefs with best move, confidence, upside, risk, and data used
- Phase 7 read-only browser extension overlay shell for Sleeper, Yahoo, and ESPN
- Phase 8 League Twin simulator with manager twins, waiver heat, trade windows, and playoff lanes
- Phase 9 news and social intelligence with signal clusters, source scores, alerts, and draft review
- Phase 10 dynasty and draft brain with prospect grades, landing fits, rookie plans, and trade values
- Phase 11 Yahoo and ESPN platform hub with OAuth readiness, overlay-first mapping, and normalized league snapshots
- Phase 12 testing and evaluation lab with baselines, ROI, calibration, regression suites, and feedback actions
- Phase 13 offseason beta launch cockpit with demo QA, sandbox testing, waitlist cohorts, launch checklist, and feedback operations
- Phase 13.1 early-access intake with persistent submissions, cohort routing, launch-fit scoring, and recent routed users
- Phase 13.2 launch ops control room with status workflow, mock-data controls, aggregate reset, filters, and CSV export
- Player start/sit ratings
- Coach tendency model
- Defensive matchup model
- League Twin simulator
- Trade negotiation suggestions
- Waiver FAAB planner
- News trust scoring
- Social content queue
- Dynasty and rookie prospect panel
